app.title: R6 Draft Sim
app.subtitle: DRAFT SIM
menu.tagline: Draft, bans, droning, reinforcements and turn-based action phases: set your plan and the engine resolves each phase.
menu.cpuDesc: Full match against the decision engine.
menu.hostDesc: Generates a code for your friend (P2P, no accounts).
menu.dataNote: Map data (bomb sites and spawns) gathered from public sources with a confidence level; spawn entries and spawn effects are an abstract model. Operator values are our own approximations.
net.shareCode: Give this code to your friend:
net.waitGuest: Waiting for them to join... (keep this tab open)
net.noRoom: No room exists with that code.
net.silence: No signal from the rival for {s} s. If they do not return, press Menu.
ui.whyLegend: Green: factor in the winner's favour · Red: factor in the loser's favour that was not enough.
ui.compEmpty: Select operators to see your composition.
ui.spawnUndocumented: Spawn not documented in public sources (generic model).
role.anchor.desc: Stays on site with reinforcements and utility.
role.rotate.desc: Covers rotations between the site and surroundings.
role.roam.desc: Plays off-site to ambush and flank.
role.hunt.desc: Goes out to destroy drones during prep.
role.entry.desc: Opens the way with aggressive duels.
role.intel.desc: Dedicates their drones to the sweep (100 % effective).
role.flank.desc: Watches and hunts roamers from behind.
role.support.desc: Covers the planter and heals the team.
reinf.site.desc: Reinforce the objective room walls: slows soft entry.
reinf.entry.desc: Perimeter doors and windows: slows flash/smoke entries and ground routes.
reinf.hatch.desc: Floors and ceilings: slows roof and basement routes.
stage.planDef.needSite: Choose a bomb site to continue
mapinfo.laneNote: Each spawn lane (front/side/rear) is our own abstract model, not official data.
mapinfo.rawNote: Text as recorded by the research (in Spanish).
phase.early.title: Map control
phase.entry.title: Entry
phase.site.title: Site execution
phase.plant.title: Plant
phase.post.title: Post-plant
phase.early.att.goal: Approach the building and decide how much time to spend on the exterior.
phase.early.def.goal: Decide whether roamers wait, push out, or hunt drones.
phase.entry.att.goal: Choose where you enter and how you open the way (breach, soft entry or flash).
phase.entry.def.goal: Anticipate the entry route and choose how to receive it.
phase.site.att.goal: Choose how you clear the site.
phase.site.def.goal: Choose how you hold the site.
phase.plant.att.goal: Plant now or spend time clearing first.
phase.plant.def.goal: Decide whether to cut the plant or wait to retake.
phase.post.att.goal: Position your team to protect the defuser.
phase.post.def.goal: Decide how you try to defuse.
dec.early.att.approach.standard.desc: Advance in order and read the map.
dec.early.att.approach.rush.desc: Enter before reinforcements and traps are finished. You ignore intel and expose the team.
dec.early.att.approach.flank.desc: Part of the team hunts roamers. More time, fewer people at the entry.
dec.early.def.stance.hold.desc: Roamers stay near the site. Full setup: defensive bonus all round.
dec.early.def.stance.contest.desc: Roamers seek contact with an ambush.
dec.early.def.stance.hunt.desc: You destroy active drones: the attacker loses information.
dec.entry.att.route.ground.desc: Entry through perimeter doors and windows.
dec.entry.att.route.roof.desc: Rappel from the roof: ideal for upper-floor sites.
dec.entry.att.route.basement.desc: Access through the basement or tunnels: ideal for basement sites.
dec.entry.att.method.hard.desc: Open reinforced walls with your breachers. Anti-breach can stop you.
dec.entry.att.method.soft.desc: Soft walls and vertical play. Site reinforcements slow it.
dec.entry.att.method.flash.desc: Enter through the door with utility. Reinforced entries slow it.
dec.entry.def.watch.ground.desc: You bet they come through the ground floor.
dec.entry.def.watch.roof.desc: You bet they come from the roof.
dec.entry.def.watch.basement.desc: You bet they come from the basement.
dec.entry.def.stance.crossfire.desc: Cover the entries with aggressive crossfire.
dec.entry.def.stance.fallback.desc: Give up the entry and fall back: costs time but avoids trades.
dec.site.att.style.methodical.desc: Utility first, clearing angle by angle. Slow but safe.
dec.site.att.style.aggressive.desc: Enter fast for frags. Faster, more trades.
dec.site.att.style.split.desc: Two fronts with a flank. Needs at least 3 alive.
dec.site.def.stance.peek.desc: Aggressive peeks to win duels. More trades.
dec.plant.att.action.clear.desc: One extra clearing wave before planting.
dec.plant.def.stance.deny.desc: All-in on the planter: big edge if you catch it.
dec.plant.def.stance.bait.desc: No risk: you prepare the retake and defuse.
dec.post.def.stance.retake.desc: Everyone to the site now: more duels, more trades.
dec.post.def.stance.wait.desc: Wait for a safer defuse window.
dec.post.def.stance.fake.desc: Fake it to pull attackers out of position.
stage.ban.title: Ban phase
stage.ban.sub: Ban a rival operator ({n}/{max} bans this half). Bans accumulate until the sides swap.
stage.pick.title: Pick your squad
stage.pick.subPool: Pick 5 from your random pool of {n}.
stage.planDef.title: Defence plan
stage.planDef.sub: Choose the bomb site, spread reinforcements and assign each operator a role. The rival sees none of this except what their drones discover.
stage.planAtt.title: Attack plan
stage.planAtt.sub: Choose a spawn, the drone order and roles. After the drone phase you can change spawn.
stage.planAtt.drone: Drone sweep: choose the order of sites to scout (up to ~{n} sweeps)
stage.planAtt.droneHelp: Defenders can destroy and block your drones; a failed sweep reveals nothing.
stage.prep.title: Preparation phase
stage.adjust.title: After the drone phase
stage.adjust.sub: With what you found out, you can change spawn and roles before they lock.
stage.adjust.notFound: You did not locate the site: you will have to guess the route.
ev.prep.scoutLost: The drone scouting {site} is destroyed or blocked.
ev.prep.notFound: The drone sweep did not locate the site.
ev.early.noContact: {who} finds nobody and ends up out of position.
ev.entry.noBreacher: No breacher alive: attackers lose a lot of time and angles.
ev.entry.breachKilled: The reinforcement holds: {killer} protects the wall and eliminates {victim}.
ev.entry.breachDenied: {who} tries to breach but anti-breach stops them.
enum.reason.defElimPlanted: defenders eliminated with the bomb planted
enum.reason.plantedMutual: mutual elimination with the bomb planted
enum.reason.timeout: time runs out without a plant
reason.defElimPlanted: defenders eliminated with the bomb planted
reason.plantedMutual: mutual elimination with the bomb planted
reason.timeout: time runs out without a plant
why.info.att: Information edge for attackers ({v}): drones and intel beat the defensive blocking.
why.info.def: Information edge for defenders ({v}): drone blocking and defensive intel outweighed the attackers.
why.notFound: Attackers did not locate the site during the drone phase and had to guess the route.
why.found: Attackers located the site during preparation.
why.noHB: Attackers had no hard breach alive or available: no openings, fewer angles and lots of lost time.
why.hbDenied: {n} breach attempt(s) stopped by reinforcements and anti-breach protection.
why.roam: Roam phase: {k} defender kill(s) against {l} roamer(s) lost.
why.anticipated: Defenders anticipated the entry route and caught the attackers in a crossfire.
why.routeGood: The entry route suited the site floor well.
why.routeBad: The entry route suited the site floor poorly.
why.respawn: Attackers changed spawn after the drone phase to fit the site.
why.defused: Defenders defused the bomb in time.
spec.support.desc: Helps the team with healing, armor or utility.
spec.map_control.desc: Controls space and lines of sight.
spec.front-line.desc: Leads the push and takes the first fights.
spec.anti-entry.desc: Stops attackers from entering the site.
spec.trapper.desc: Delays and punishes attackers with traps.
gadget.deployable_shield.desc: Bulletproof shield that's deployed on the ground or attached to doorframes to provide protective cover.
gadget.nitro_cell.desc: Throwable C4 that sticks to surfaces and is manually detonated to create a large explosion.
gadget.impact_grenade.desc: Explosive grenade that detonates on impact to create entryways or line of sight in breakable surfaces.
gadget.barbed_wire.desc: Non-damaging razor wire that slows opponents and creates noise when walked through.
gadget.bulletproof_camera.desc: Camera that sees through smoke and manually fires EMP bursts to deactivate opponent electronic devices.
gadget.proximity_alarm.desc: Sensor that sticks to surfaces and sounds an alarm when it detects nearby opponents.
gadget.observation_blocker.desc: Projects a screen that blocks the line of sight of opponent Observation Tools.
gadget.frag_grenade.desc: Explosive grenade that detonates shortly after being thrown.
gadget.smoke_grenade.desc: Non-damaging grenade that produces smoke shortly after being thrown to cover advances.
gadget.stun_grenade.desc: Non-damaging grenade that produces a flash explosion shortly after being thrown to disorient opponents.
gadget.claymore.desc: Explosive trap that's deployed on the ground and is useful against roaming Defenders.
gadget.hard_breach_charge.desc: Explosive device that automatically detonates to create entryways in breakable and reinforced surfaces.
gadget.breach_charge.desc: Explosive device that's deployed on breakable surfaces and is manually detonated to create an entryway.
gadget.impact_emp_grenade.desc: Non-damaging impact grenade that temporarily deactivates nearby opponent electronic devices.
ability.s_e_l_m_a_aqua_breacher.desc: Throwable breach charge that creates line of sight or entryways in breakable and reinforced surfaces.
ability.garra_hook.desc: Grappling gun that provides a quick rappel up ledges and windows at limited distances.
ability.breaching_rounds.desc: Launcher with explosive rounds that destroy utility and create entryways in breakable surfaces.
ability.rifle_shield.desc: Primary weapon shield attachment that provides frontal protection from headshots before breaking.
ability.flash_shield.desc: Ballistic shield with a flash attachment that can be activated to temporarily blind Operators.
ability.kludge_drone.desc: Deployable drone that either takes control of electronic devices or destroys them after a short delay.
ability.skeleton_key.desc: Primary weapon shotgun attachment used to create entryways or line of sight in breakable surfaces.
ability.tactical_crossbow.desc: Crossbow that fires Incendiary Bolts for area control and Micro Smoke Grenades to cover advances.
ability.deathmark_tracker.desc: Small probe that reveals an Opponent and Deimos to each other for a limited time.
ability.logic_bomb.desc: Calls Defender phones to compromise their locations, interrupt use of Observation Tools and leave them open to hacking.
ability.adrenal_surge.desc: Gives Finka and her team a health boost or revive and enhances their combat capabilities.
ability.rce_ratero_charge.desc: Remote-controlled charge that anchors to a surface and becomes bulletproof, then detonates.
ability.cluster_charge.desc: Charge that's deployed on breakable and reinforced surfaces to injure opponents and clear devices on the other side.
ability.flip_sight.desc: Magnifying scope that's equipped onto the primary weapon to outline opponents and see through smoke.
ability.trax_stingers.desc: Device that deploys barbed mats to slow and injure opponents that walk on them.
ability.kawan_hive_launcher.desc: Launcher that fires a canister, releasing a swarm of bots that reveals opponents passing through it for a limited time.
ability.x_kairos.desc: Fires pellets that are manually detonated to create line of sight or entryways in breakable and reinforced surfaces.
ability.gemini_replicator.desc: Deploys a remote-controlled hologram of lana to deceive opponents and gather intel.
ability.electronics_detector.desc: Wearable device that locates nearby electronics through objects and surfaces.
ability.eyenox_model_iii.desc: Headgear that can be activated to reveal opponent footprints and scan them to ping the opponent's location.
ability.lv_explosive_lance.desc: Under-barrel projectile on primary weapon that detonates to destroy devices on either side of breakable and reinforced surfaces.
ability.ee_one_d.desc: Drone that hovers above the map and scans it for movement to reveal opponent locations.
ability.breaching_torch.desc: Blowtorch that quietly burns holes to create line of sight or entryways in breakable and reinforced surfaces.
ability.extendable_shield.desc: Shield that can be extended for full frontal protection to gather intel and provide cover for teammates.
ability.airjab_launcher.desc: Primary weapon attachment that fires a device that detonates and pushes Operators to the ground.
ability.hel_presence_reduction.desc: Wipes Nøkk's image from nearby drones and Observation Tools and muffles the sound of her movement.
ability.talon_8_clear_shield.desc: Transparent, bulletproof shield that can be carried or deployed on the ground and entryways.
ability.bu_gi_auto_breacher.desc: Deployable mini-tank that moves along a set path destroying devices and breakable surfaces in its way.
ability.dom_panel_launcher.desc: Deploys bulletproof panels from a distance; they can be opened or closed with a trigger at the top of the door.
ability.r_o_u_projector_system.desc: Throwable device that rolls and drops projectors to create a screen that blocks line of sight.
ability.tactical_breaching_hammer.desc: Hammer that creates entryways or line of sight in breakable surfaces and destroys bulletproof devices.
ability.emp_grenade.desc: Non-damaging grenade that temporarily deactivates nearby opponent electronic devices.
ability.exothermic_charge.desc: Explosive device that's manually detonated to create large entryways in breakable and reinforced surfaces.
ability.shock_drones.desc: Drone that manually fires lasers to clear rooms of opponent devices.
ability.candela.desc: Device that deploys a cluster of flash charges to temporarily blind Operators.
ability.argus_launcher.desc: Launcher that deploys cameras capable of piercing into breakable and reinforced surfaces to surveil both sides.
ability.ks79_lifeline.desc: Launcher that fires two types of grenades to disorient opponents or create entryways in breakable surfaces.
ability.prisma.desc: Deploys holograms of Alibi that reveal an opponent's location when fired upon or interacted with.
ability.surya_gate.desc: Laser gate that denies entry and intel by injuring opponents and destroying devices that pass through it.
ability.kiba_barrier.desc: Throwable device that sticks to surfaces and creates a bulletproof barrier that blocks entryways and line of sight.
ability.shock_wire.desc: Electrical device that's deployed on the ground to electrify nearby metal utility.
ability.armor_panel.desc: Bulletproof barricades that are deployed on windows and doors to deny entry to opponents.
ability.silent_step.desc: Move around quietly to sneak up on opponents and down them, then interrogate them to reveal opponent positions.
ability.cce_shield.desc: Extendable electro-shield that protects against incoming rushes by slowing opponents and injuring them over time.
ability.trip_connector.desc: When two devices are placed in line of sight a laser forms between them. Enemies that trip it are slowed and injured; more devices create a larger laser web that denies a room.
ability.stim_pistol.desc: Fires a shot that provides Doc and his team with a health boost or revive from a distance.
ability.yokai.desc: Drone that can hover on ceilings and manually fires sonic bursts to stun opponents and interrupt their actions.
ability.grzmot_mine.desc: Concussion mine that sticks to surfaces and detonates when it detects nearby opponents to disorient them.
ability.f_natt_dread_mine.desc: Throwable device that sticks to surfaces and releases a fear-inducing gas when it detects nearby opponents.
ability.welcome_mat.desc: Floor trap that instantly downs opponents and prevents them from moving.
ability.volcan_shield.desc: Incendiary bomb in a partially bulletproof casing that creates fire when destroyed.
ability.active_defense_system.desc: Deployable device that intercepts and destroys projectiles before they detonate.
ability.rtila_electroclaw.desc: Electrical device that sticks to surfaces and electrifies nearby metal utility.
ability.entry_denial_device.desc: Explosive trap that's attached to doorframes and window frames.
ability.gu_mines.desc: Toxic mines that inject a compound, injuring opponents and limiting their speed
ability.evil_eye.desc: Bulletproof camera with a turret that manually fires lasers to injure opponents or destroy devices.
ability.banshee_sonic_defense.desc: Bulletproof device that activates when opponents are near and uses sound to slow them.
ability.black_mirror.desc: Device that's deployed on breakable or reinforced walls to create a bulletproof one-way window.
ability.pest_launcher.desc: Launches bots that automatically latch onto opponent drones in range to take control of them.
ability.signal_disruptor.desc: Signal jammer that deactivates opponent electronic devices in range.
ability.horus_lance_launcher.desc: Fires 5 projectiles that pierce shields and destructible surfaces before erupting into flames. They can pass through floors, ceilings and adjacent rooms.
ability.remah_dash.desc: Dash attack that creates entryways in breakable walls, pushes opponents to the ground, and allows for faster roaming.
ability.heartbeat_sensor.desc: Detects the heartbeats of nearby opponents through objects and surfaces.
ability.armor_pack.desc: A pack of armor plates that give teammates additional health and protect them against elimination one time.
ability.v10_pantheon_shells.desc: Controls two linked shells: one operated directly and one acting as a shielded observation tool. She can switch between them but only operate one at a time; losing either shell severs the connection to both.
ability.remote_gas_grenade.desc: Throwable canister that sticks to surfaces and manually detonates to release a cloud of toxic gas.
ability.spec_io_electro_sensor.desc: Device that identifies opponent electronic devices, then scans them to ping their locations.
ability.shumikha_launcher.desc: Launches incendiary grenades that create a fire on detonation.
ability.razorbloom_shell.desc: Throwable device that sticks to surfaces and sends out a set of sharp blades when it detects nearby opponents.
ability.kona_station.desc: Device that automatically heals or revives any injured Operators in range, including opponents.
ability.zoto_canister.desc: Throwable device that sticks to surfaces and releases a freezing gas, deactivating devices and slowing enemies.
ability.black_eye.desc: Throwable cameras that stick to surfaces and can be used by Valkyrie and her team to gather intel.
ability.erc_7.desc: Wipes Vigil's image from nearby drones and Observation Tools so he can't be scanned.
ability.mag_net_system.desc: Throwable device that captures incoming grenades and projectiles and detonates them after a delay.
ability.glance_smart_glasses.desc: Eyewear that improves visibility in smoke and protects against flash blindness.
sheet.simNote: Each value adds the operator's base profile (their ability) and the effect of their gadgets. These are the figures the engine uses.
sheet.noStats: No effect of its own on the engine stats.
action.caveira.silent_step.desc: Move silently through the outer map to ambush an attacker: you down them and decide whether to finish them or interrogate them.
action.caveira.silent_step.counters: Countered in the game by: Jackal, Lion, Dokkaebi, Deimos, Gridlock, Nomad.
action.caveira.silent_step.opt.hunt_fini: Ambush with an aim bonus; if you down someone you finish them at once.
action.caveira.silent_step.opt.hunt_inte: If you down someone you interrogate for 5 s: if nobody catches you the whole attacking team is revealed; if they do, you die.
action.jackal.eyenox.desc: Tracks defenders' footprints to mark one, preferring roamers.
action.jackal.eyenox.counters: Countered in the game by: Mute (the jammer disables it) and Caveira (Silent Step).
action.jackal.eyenox.opt.track.desc: Marks a defender this phase and the next; a marked roamer loses the element of surprise.
action.mute.signal_disruptor.desc: Jammers that disable the enemy's drones, remote charges, healing and tracking for the whole round.
action.mute.signal_disruptor.counters: Countered in the game by: Thatcher and impact EMPs, and Twitch's lasers.
action.mute.signal_disruptor.opt.jam.des: Strengthens the defence against breaching and slows the enemy's charges, healing and tracking all round.
action.bandit.shock_wire.desc: Electrifies reinforcements, barbed wire and shields: electronics that touch them are destroyed.
action.bandit.shock_wire.counters: Countered in the game by: Thatcher and impact EMPs, and IQ (detects it).
action.bandit.shock_wire.opt.electrify.d: Strong protection against hard breaching; an exothermic charge is destroyed on touching the wall.
action.pulse.heartbeat_sensor.desc: Detects attackers by their heartbeat through walls.
action.pulse.heartbeat_sensor.counters: Countered in the game by: Thatcher and impact EMPs, and IQ (locates it while scanning).
action.pulse.heartbeat_sensor.opt.scan.d: Reveals 2 attackers this phase; known attackers lose their edge in duels. Adrenal Surge extends the range.
action.thermite.exothermic_charge.desc: A charge that breaks through reinforcements in three seconds.
action.thermite.exothermic_charge.counte: Countered in the game by: Mute, Bandit and Kaid (electrified wall), Maestro and impact grenades.
action.thermite.exothermic_charge.opt.ex: Greatly improves this phase's hard breach; Mute's or Bandit's gadgets can neutralise it.
action.finka.adrenal_surge.desc: A health and combat boost for the whole attacking team; revives a downed teammate or itself.
action.finka.adrenal_surge.counters: Countered in the game by: Mute (it can't be activated within the jammer's range).
action.finka.adrenal_surge.opt.surge.des: Better own aim and weaker enemy aim; revives a downed teammate. Mute's jammer slows it.
ui.actionPersist: Stays in place for the whole round
